description: According to CDC projections, Sickle Cell Disease affects about 100,000 Americans, including 3,000 Marylanders, but has gone relatively unnoticed. In truth, we don’t know exactly how many people live with the disease or how many more may be carriers.
title: Sickle Cell Disease Needs More State and Federal Attention - Delegate Heather Bagnall — Heather Bagnall - Maryland State Delegate - District 33
